answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the crystal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The falcon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the pearl is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work.
